verses.en: In the mean time, when there were gathered together an innumerable multitude of people, insomuch that they trode one upon another, he began to say unto his disciples first of all, Beware ye of the leaven of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.
verses.sm: UA faapotopoto mai le motu °12 tagata e manomano a o faia la mea, ua latou fesoliai ai, ona oo atu lea o lana lauga i ona soo, la outou matuā ‘alo ese i le mea faafefete a le au faresaio, o le pepelo lea.

verses.en: For there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; neither hid, that shall not be known.
verses.sm: Auā e leai se mea o loo ufiufitia, e le faaalia; e leai foi se mea lilo e le faailoaina,

verses.en: Therefore whatsoever ye have spoken in darkness shall be heard in the light; and that which ye have spoken in the ear in closets shall be proclaimed upon the housetops.
verses.sm: O lea foi, o mea uma ua outou fai atu ai i le pouliuli, e logoina lea i le malamalama ; o le mea foi ua outou tala lemu atu i afeafe, e tala‘iina lea i luga o fale.

verses.en: And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.
verses.sm: A ou te fai atu ia te outou na a‘u uo, aua tou te matatau ia te i latou o e fasioti le tino ; a mavae lea, ua leai se toe mea latou te mafaia.

verses.en: But I will forewarn you whom ye shall fear: Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell; yea, I say unto you, Fear him.
verses.sm: A e ou te faasino atu ia te outou i le tou te matatau i ai; ia outou matatau ia te ia, a mavae ona fasioti e ia, e ana le pule e lafo atu i Kena; e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, ia outou matatau ia te ia.

verses.en: Are not five sparrows sold for two farthings, and not one of them is forgotten before God?
verses.sm: E le faataulia ea manu iti e lima gafua i asari e lua? e leai foi so latou e tasi ua galo i luma o le Atua.

verses.en: But even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Fear not therefore: ye are of more value than many sparrows.
verses.sm: A o outou lauulu lava ua faitaulia uma ia. O lena, aua tou te matatau ai; ua sili outou i manu iti e tele.

verses.en: Also I say unto you, Whosoever shall confess me before men, him shall the Son of man also confess before the angels of God:
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu foi ia te outou, O se ta‘ua a‘u i luma o tagata, e ta‘ua foi o ia e le Atalii o le tagata i luma o agelu a le Atua.

verses.en: But he that denieth me before men shall be denied before the angels of God.
verses.sm: A o le faafiti mai ia te au i luma o tagata, e faafitia o ia i luma o agelu a le Atua.

verses.en: And whosoever shall speak a word against the Son of man, it shall be forgiven him: but unto him that blasphemeth against the Holy Ghost it shall not be forgiven.
verses.sm: O se lafo foi se upu i le Atalii o le tagata, e faamagaloina lea; a o le upu leaga i le Agaga Paia, e le faamagaloina lea.

verses.en: And when they bring you unto the synagogues, and unto magistrates, and powers, take ye no thought how or what thing ye shall answer, or what ye shall say:
verses.sm: Pe a ta‘i afiina outou i sunako, ma alii, ma faipule, aua tou te popole i sa outou e tafi atu, pe faapefea, pe se a f A tou te fai atu ai;

verses.en: For the Holy Ghost shall teach you in the same hour what ye ought to say.
verses.sm: auā e a‘oa‘o le Agaga Paia ia te outou i lea lava itu aso i upu e tatau ona fai atu ai.

verses.en: And one of the company said unto him, Master, speak to my brother, that he divide the inheritance with me.
verses.sm: Ua fai mai ia te ia le tasi mai le motu o tagata, Le a‘oa‘o e, ia e fetalai ane i lo‘u uso, ina ia va. luaina mai le tofi ia te au.

verses.en: And he said unto him, Man, who made me a judge or a divider over you?
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu o ia ia te ia, Sole, o ai ea le na fai a‘u ma faamasino ma pule ia te outou?

verses.en: And he said unto them, Take heed, and beware of covetousness: for a man's life consisteth not in the abundance of the things which he possesseth.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia t' i latou, la outou, ia leoleo outou ia te outou auā le matapeapea ; auā e le ola se tasi i le tele o ana mea ua ia te ia.

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth plentifully:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia ia te i latou le faataoto, ua faapea atu, Ka fua tele mai le fanua o le tasi tagata mauoa;

verses.en: And he thought within himself, saying, What shall I do, because I have no room where to bestow my fruits?
verses.sm: ona manatunatu ifo lea o ia, ua faapea, Se a se mea ou te faia auā e leai sa‘u mea. e faaputu ai a‘u fua?

verses.en: And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.
verses.sm: Ua fai ane foi o ia, O lenei le mea ou te faia; ou te sa‘ena o‘u fale saito, a e faia ia tele; ou te faaputu i ai a‘u fua ma a‘u mea lelei uma,

verses.en: And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.
verses.sm: Ou te fai ifo foi i lo‘u agaga, Lou agaga e, ua ia te oe mea lelei e tele ua teuina mo tausaga e tele; ina nofonofo filemu ia, ina ‘ai ia, ma inu ma ia e olioli.

verses.en: But God said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?
verses.sm: A ua fetalai atu le Atua ia te ia, O oe na le vale, e aamiina atu lou agaga nai ia te oe i le po nanei; a e fai ma ai mea ia ua e saunia?

verses.en: So is he that layeth up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.
verses.sm: O loo faapea foi le faaputu oa ia te ia, a e le mauoa i le Atua.

verses.en: And he said unto his disciples, Therefore I say unto you, Take no thought for your life, what ye shall eat; neither for the body, what ye shall put on.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia i ona soo, O lea ou te fai atu ai ia te outou, aua tou te popole i lo outou ola, i mea tou te aai ai, po o le tino, i mea tou te oofu ai.

verses.en: The life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment.
verses.sm: Ua sili le ola i le mea e ‘ai, ua sili foi le tino i le ofu.

verses.en: Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls?
verses.sm: la outou mafaufau i oreva ; latou te le lulu saito, latou te le selesele foi; e leai lava so latou afeafe, po o se fale saito, a e fagaina i latou e le Atua; e le sili ea lo outou lelei, i manu?

verses.en: And which of you with taking thought can add to his stature one cubit?
verses.sm: O ai ea so outou u imafai ia te ia i lona popole ona faateleina le umi o lona olagai le kupita e tasi ?

verses.en: If ye then be not able to do that thing which is least, why take ye thought for the rest?
verses.sm: Afai foi tou te le mafai i se mea itiiti lava, se a le mea tou te popole ai i nisi mea ?

verses.en: Consider the lilies how they grow: they toil not, they spin not; and yet I say unto you, that Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.
verses.sm: la outou mafaufau i lautalo alo pe faapefea ona tupu ; latou te le galue, e le milo foi; a ou te fai atu ia te outou, e lei ofu lava Solomona ma lona matagofie tele pei o le tasi o na mea.

verses.en: If then God so clothe the grass, which is to day in the field, and to morrow is cast into the oven; how much more will he clothe you, O ye of little faith?
verses.sm: Afai e faapea ona faaofuina e le Atua le vao o i le fanua, o ola mai i le asō, a e lafoina a taeao i le ogāumu; e le sili ea ona faaofuina outou e ia o outou e faatuatua itiiii ?

verses.en: And seek not ye what ye shall eat, or what ye shall drink, neither be ye of doubtful mind.
verses.sm: O outou f ;i, aua tou te saili pe ni a tou te aA ai, ni a foi tou te inu ai ; aua foi le feave iina o outou loto.

verses.en: For all these things do the nations of the world seek after: and your Father knoweth that ye have need of these things.
verses.sm: Auā o mea uma ia ua sailia e nuu o le lalolagi; ua silafia foi e lo outou Tamā o ia mea e aoga ia te outou.

verses.en: But rather seek ye the kingdom of God; and all these things shall be added unto you.
verses.sm: A ia outou saili le malo o le Atua; ona faaopoopoina ai lea o ia mea uma ia te outou.

verses.en: Fear not, little flock; for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the kingdom.
verses.sm: Aua e te fefe oe le lafu mamoe itiiti e; auā ua finagalo lo outou Tamā e foai mai le malo ia te outou.

verses.en: Sell that ye have, and give alms; provide yourselves bags which wax not old, a treasure in the heavens that faileth not, where no thief approacheth, neither moth corrupteth.
verses.sm: Ia outou faatau atu i a outou mea, tou te avatu ai e fai ma mea alofa; ia fai outou ni o outou taga e anagata, o le oa i le lagi e le uma lava, e le tāitai ane i ai se gaoi, e le atia foi e se mogamoga,

verses.en: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.
verses.sm: Auā o le mea o i ai lo outou oa, e i ai atoa foi ma o outou loto.

verses.en: Let your loins be girded about, and your lights burning;
verses.sm: la fusia o outou sulugātiti, ma ia mumū a outou lamepa; e faatali atu i lo latou alii,

verses.en: And ye yourselves like unto men that wait for their lord, when he will return from the wedding; that when he cometh and knocketh, they may open unto him immediately.
verses.sm: seia foi mai o ia mai le tausamaaga; ia latou to loa mai le puipui ia te ia pe a sau, ma tu‘itu‘i mai.

verses.en: Blessed are those servants, whom the lord when he cometh shall find watching: verily I say unto you, that he shall gird himself, and make them to sit down to meat, and will come forth and serve them.
verses.sm: Amuia ia auauna e maua i latou e lo latou alii, o mataala pe a sau. E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, e fusi e ia ona ofu, ma fai atu ia te i latou ia taooto e aai, ma alu ane lava, ma auauna ia te i iatou.

verses.en: And if he shall come in the second watch, or come in the third watch, and find them so, blessed are those servants.
verses.sm: Pe afai e sau ia i le leoleoga e lua o le po, pe sau i le leoleoga e tolu, a maua o i latou o faapea, amuia ia auauna.

verses.en: And this know, that if the goodman of the house had known what hour the thief would come, he would have watched, and not have suffered his house to be broken through.
verses.sm: A ia outou iloa. lenei mea, ana iloa e le matai o le aiga le itu po e sau ai le gaoi, po ua na leoleoina, a e le tuua e ia lona fale ia elia.

verses.en: Be ye therefore ready also: for the Son of man cometh at an hour when ye think not.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia outou nofo sauni; auā o le itu aso tou te le manatunatu ai, e sau ai le Atalii o le tagata.

verses.en: Then Peter said unto him, Lord, speakest thou this parable unto us, or even to all?
verses.sm: Oaa fai mai lea o Peteru ia te ia, Le Alii e, ua e fetalai mai ea lena faataoto ia te i matou, po o tagata uma ?

verses.en: And the Lord said, Who then is that faithful and wise steward, whom his lord shall make ruler over his household, to give them their portion of meat in due season?
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea. o le Alii, O ai foi le auauna e pule ua faamaoni ma le mafaufau, ua tofia e lona alii e pule i ana auauna, ia avatu mea e ‘ai ia te i latou i ona itu aso ?

verses.en: Blessed is that servant, whom his lord when he cometh shall find so doing.
verses.sm: Amuia lea auauna, pe a sau lona alii e maua ia o loo faapea ona fai.

verses.en: Of a truth I say unto you, that he will make him ruler over all that he hath.
verses.sm: E moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, na te tofia o ia e pule i ana mea uma.

verses.en: But and if that servant say in his heart, My lord delayeth his coming; and shall begin to beat the menservants and maidens, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken;
verses.sm: A e afai e fai ifo lea auauna i lona loto, E faatuai mai lo‘u alii; ona fasi ai lea o ia i auauna tane ma auauna fafine, e ‘ai foi, ma inu, ma onā.

verses.en: The lord of that servant will come in a day when he looketh not for him, and at an hour when he is not aware, and will cut him in sunder, and will appoint him his portion with the unbelievers.
verses.sm: E sau lava le alii o lea auauna i le aso e le faatalitali atu ai o ia, o le itu aso foi e le iloa ai e ia; ona matuā faasala lea ia te ia, ma avatu lona tofi faatasi ma e le faalogo.

verses.en: And that servant, which knew his lord's will, and prepared not himself, neither did according to his will, shall be beaten with many stripes.
verses.sm: O lea auauna foi ua na iloa le finagalo o lona Alii, a e lei sauni lava ia, e lei faia foi mea e tatau ma lona finagalo, e tele ona sasaina.

verses.en: But he that knew not, and did commit things worthy of stripes, shall be beaten with few stripes. For unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall be much required: and to whom men have committed much, of him they will ask the more.
verses.sm: A o le ua le iloa, ua faia foi e ia mea e tatau ina sasaina ai, e māmā ona sasaina o ia. Auā o le ua foaiina atu i ai o mea e tele, e sueina atu foi ia te ia o mea e tele; o ia foi ua tuuina atu i ai o mea e tele, latou te fai atu ia te ia e au mai mea e sili ona tele.

verses.en: I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?
verses.sm: Ua ou sau e lafo le afi i le lalolagi; se a se mea ou te toe manao i ai, pe ana mu nei lava?

verses.en: But I have a baptism to be baptized with; and how am I straitened till it be accomplished!
verses.sm: O lo‘u papatisoga o le a tiga lava seia faaiuina.

verses.en: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
verses.sm: Fa te outou ea ua ou sau e avatu le filemu i le lalolagi ? Ou te fai atu ia te outou, e leai; a o le fevaevaeai.

verses.en: For from henceforth there shall be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.
verses.sm: Auā e amata i nei ona po e i ai i le fale e tasi tagata e toalima e fevaevaeai i latou, o le toatolu e faamasesei ma le toalua, o le toalua foi e faamasesei ma le toatolu.

verses.en: The father shall be divided against the son, and the son against the father; the mother against the daughter, and the daughter against the mother; the mother in law against her daughter in law, and the daughter in law against her mother in law.
verses.sm: E fevaevaeai le tamā ma le atalii, o le atalii foi ma le tamā; o le tinā ma le tama teine, o le tama teine foi ma le tinā ; o le tinā o le tane ma le avā a lana tama, o le avā foi ma le tinā o lana tane.

verses.en: And he said also to the people, When ye see a cloud rise out of the west, straightway ye say, There cometh a shower; and so it is.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia i le motu o tagata, Pe a outou iloa le ao o loo alu ae i sisifo, ona outou fai ane loa lea, Anei e ua; ona taunuu foi lea.

verses.en: And when ye see the south wind blow, ye say, There will be heat; and it cometh to pass.
verses.sm: A agi mai foi le toga, ua outou fai ane, Anei e la ; ona taunuu foi lea.

verses.en: Ye hypocrites, ye can discern the face of the sky and of the earth; but how is it that ye do not discern this time?
verses.sm: O outou tagata pepelo, ua outou iloa ona mātauina le amio a le lagi ma le lalolagi; se a foi le mea tou te le mātauina ai le uiga o lenei tausaga ?

verses.en: Yea, and why even of yourselves judge ye not what is right?
verses.sm: Se a foi le mea tou te le filifili ai e outou i mea tonu ?

verses.en: When thou goest with thine adversary to the magistrate, as thou art in the way, give diligence that thou mayest be delivered from him; lest he hale thee to the judge, and the judge deliver thee to the officer, and the officer cast thee into prison.
verses.sm: Pe a lua ō i le alii ma le ua e aitalafu ai, ia e taumafai lava i le ala ina ia oulua lelei ma ia; ne‘i toso o ia ia te oe i le faamasino, e tuu atu foi le faamasino ia te oe i le auauna, ona tuuina atu lea oe e le auauna i le fale puipui.

verses.en: I tell thee, thou shalt not depart thence, till thou hast paid the very last mite.
verses.sm: Ou te fai atu ia te oe, e te le toe ulufafo ai, seia e avatu tupe uma lava.
